text:
Items before: a cheese-topped English muffin or crumpet (about 150 kcal with the cheese crust), 2 poached or fried eggs (about 140 kcal), roasted tomato halves (about 20 kcal), a few mushrooms (about 5 kcal), blueberries (about 60 g, 35 kcal), a slice of fruit toast (about 90 kcal), and a latte (about 120 kcal, 200 g milk).

After: the plates are nearly empty, with only some yolk and crumbs left. The cup has a little residue. Nearly everything was eaten.

Total is about 150+140+20+5+35+90+120 = 560 kcal. Taking off about 5% for leftovers gives about 540 kcal.

Mass: muffin 75, eggs 100, tomato 50, mushroom 15, blueberries 60, toast 45, latte 200 = 545 g. After leftovers, about 520 g.
